name: fix93_item_skill

steps: log -- the CP start kit wears the Orc Slayer: its perk is active through the item
notes: fix-97 (r39 'skillactive:Perk_OrcSlayer=no: was item' before any equip): the fresh hero already wears the Orc Slayer (G3HeroStart, CP InventoryAssureStartupItems), so the scenario takes it off first. The skills page shows such a perk lit while the item is worn (G3 list: normal icon when learned or ActivationCount > 0).
